name: coduck-flags-monorepo
description: Headless, deterministic feature rollout SDK for TypeScript applications

scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml 'tsconfig*.json' vitest.config.ts 'packages/**/*.{ts,json,md}' 'tests/**/*.ts' 'scripts/**/*.mjs' 'benchmarks/**/*.mjs' 'proof/**/*.mjs' '.github/**/*.yml' README.md SPEC.md SECURITY.md CONTRIBUTING.md CHANGELOG.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml 'tsconfig*.json' vitest.config.ts 'packages/**/*.{ts,json,md}' 'tests/**/*.ts' 'scripts/**/*.mjs' 'benchmarks/**/*.mjs' 'proof/**/*.mjs' '.github/**/*.yml' README.md SPEC.md SECURITY.md CONTRIBUTING.md CHANGELOG.md
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm build && pnpm publint && pnpm package:smoke
